message: pnpm 9.15.0 in GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml) does not support minimumReleaseAge and minimumReleaseAgeExclude (since 10.16.0)
fix: Require pnpm 10.16.0 or later in GitHub Actions

message: devEngines (package.json) allows pnpm 10.0.0 ("^10.0.0"), which does not support minimumReleaseAge and minimumReleaseAgeExclude (since 10.16.0)
fix: Require pnpm 10.16.0 or later in devEngines
